items.title: GSoC Week 7: Making manualintegrate Leaner
items.content_text: Week seven was less about adding new integration rules and more about tightening the logic that decides when manualintegrate should stop looking for one. Several of the pull requests I opened this week replace a heuristic that happened to work with a check that is actually justified by the structure of the problem.
